home.heroSubtitle: Residential, commercial, and renovation construction handled by a team you can trust — from foundation to finish.
home.trustBarTitle: Trusted by homeowners and businesses across Sri Lanka
home.introTitle: Two decades of <light>dedication, precision, and pride in every build.</light>
home.introBody: For over 18 years, our site teams and project managers have delivered more than 240 residential, commercial, and renovation projects across Colombo, Kandy, and beyond — holding a family home in Nugegoda to the same standard as a city office fit-out. We measure success in referrals and repeat clients, not just handovers.

whyUs.experienceBody: Nearly two decades of delivering residential and commercial projects on time and on budget.
whyUs.qualityBody: Skilled tradespeople and rigorous site supervision on every job, big or small.
whyUs.transparencyBody: Clear quotes and honest communication — no surprise costs partway through your project.
whyUs.supportBody: We stand behind our work with responsive after-handover support.

about.title: About RHA Construction
about.intro: RHA Construction has been building homes, offices, and community spaces across Sri Lanka for nearly two decades.
about.historyBody: Founded by a team of engineers and site supervisors who believed construction should mean honest work and lasting quality, RHA Construction has grown from small residential jobs into a full-service contractor trusted by homeowners, businesses, and diaspora clients building from abroad.
about.missionBody: To deliver every project — from a single-room renovation to a multi-storey commercial building — with the same standard of craftsmanship, safety, and transparency.
